1 حَزَبَهُ , (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) aor.
حَزُبَ , (Mgh, Msb,) inf. n. حَزْبٌ, (K, TA,) It (an event) befell him: (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K:) and it became severe to him; distressed him; or pressed severely, or heavily, upon him: or it straitened him, or overcame him, (K, TA,) suddenly, or unexpectedly. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
